mapper.sql: select n.note_id, n.user_id, n.target_type, n.target_id, n.note_title, n.note_content, n.progress, n.del_flag, n.create_time, n.update_time, case n.target_type when 'post' then (select p.post_title from learning_post p where p.post_id = n.target_id) when 'video' then (select concat(c.course_name, ' · ', v.video_title) from learning_course_video v join learning_course c on c.course_id = v.course_id where v.video_id = n.target_id) end as source_title, case n.target_type when 'video' then (select v.course_id from learning_course_video v where v.video_id = n.target_id) end as course_id, case n.target_type when 'post' then (select p.del_flag from learning_post p where p.post_id = n.target_id) when 'video' then (select if(v.del_flag = '0' and c.del_flag = '0', '0', '2') from learning_course_video v join learning_course c on c.course_id = v.course_id where v.video_id = n.target_id) end as source_del_flag from learning_note n
mapper.insert: insert into learning_note (user_id, target_type, target_id, note_title, note_content, progress, del_flag, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{noteTitle}, #{noteContent}, #{progress}, '0', sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update learning_note set note_title = #{noteTitle}, note_content = #{noteContent}, update_time = sysdate() where note_id = #{noteId} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
update learning_note set del_flag = '2', update_time = sysdate() where note_id = #{noteId} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_post where post_id = #{targetId} and del_flag = '0' and status = '0'
select count(*) from learning_course_video v join learning_course c on c.course_id = v.course_id where v.video_id = #{targetId} and v.del_flag = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0'
